scripts.build:gestor: tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_MODE=gestor vite build --outDir dist/gestor && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/gestor/index-gestor.html','dist/gestor/index.html')"
scripts.build:horas: tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_MODE=horas vite build --outDir dist/horas && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/horas/index-horas.html','dist/horas/index.html')"
scripts.build:producao: tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_MODE=producao vite build --outDir dist/producao && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/producao/index-producao.html','dist/producao/index.html')"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:gestor && npm run build:horas && npm run build:producao
scripts.cap:sync:all: npm run cap:sync:gestor && npm run cap:sync:horas && npm run cap:sync:producao
scripts.cap:open:gestor: cd mobile/gestor && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:horas: cd mobile/horas && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:producao: cd mobile/producao && npx cap open android
scripts.deploy:gestor: npm run build:gestor && npm run cap:sync:gestor
scripts.deploy:horas: npm run build:horas && npm run cap:sync:horas
scripts.deploy:producao: npm run build:producao && npm run cap:sync:producao
